description:
Tobacco Pipe Lot - 8 Pieces
Peterson's and Mixed Brands, Briar Wood
Vintage Era
This collection features eight vintage estate tobacco pipes, including a notable Peterson's pipe and a commemorative 1993 Christmas pipe. The lot showcases a diverse array of traditional pipe shapes, finishes, and stem materials, representing classic mid-to-late 20th-century smoking accessories. These pieces are ideal for restoration enthusiasts or as additions to a historical smoking memorabilia collection.
Peterson's K&P estate pipe featuring a silver-tone metal band
Red-finished briar pipe marked "Christmas 1993" on the shank

One detached vintage dark wood pipe bowl

All items are sold as-is for restoration or display.

Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.

Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

COMBINED SHIPPING - Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may not be combined with an unpaid item. We will only combine up to 20lbs. We reserve the right to deny combined shipping when there is a probability for damage.
When shipping with FedEx the shipping weight shown is calculated based on a dimensional weight & will sometimes appear to be inflated but is actually used to give our customers a lower shipping rate. Please use the shipping calculator provided in each auction to determine shipping costs to your specific location.
If an item is damaged during shipping, we will need a photograph of the damage to the packaging & the item, & may need a signed statement prior to a refund being issued. In the event of damage please keep all packaging & the damaged item available until a refund is issued.

description:
Vintage Ken Brown Calligraphy Kit Hunt Speedball 3078 Ink Pen Nibs Textbook
Vintage Ken Brown Calligraphy Kit by Hunt/Speedball, product number 3078. Includes 2 oz. bottle of Hunt/Speedball Super Black India Ink, black Speedball pen holder, four interchangeable Speedball C-series pen nibs, eraser, and 20th Edition Speedball Textbook for pen and brush lettering. Kit also contains practice and tracing paper. Items are gently used with some wear on ink bottle label and box. All components present and functional. Original box includes instructions and calligraphy samples.
11 x 9 x 3 in
Details
Local Pickup is now available.
Please initiate all scheduling, inquiries and notifications via your Shopgoodwill account by selecting: Contact Us then Create a New Support ticket.
Please make sure to read description, look at all pics and ask questions prior to bidding as all sales are final.
General Conditions
All items are used, sold as found, and AS IS with no warranties expressed or implied.
We are not experts in any field; descriptions are based on our best ability using available resources.
Measurements are approximate.
Please read the description, review all images, and ask questions prior to bidding. All sales are final.
Placing a bid indicates acceptance of these terms.
Jewelry & Precious Metals
We do not have a gemologist or jeweler on staff. Items are listed to the best of our ability and have not been professionally tested or serviced.
Diamonds vs. moissanite cannot be differentiated by our equipment.
Gems are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester; however, it cannot distinguish natural vs. synthetic stones, and items may have flaws, scratches, or inclusions beyond our ability to identify.
Gold-filled items are only described as marked/stamped or by magnetic properties. Actual karat levels may vary.
Magnetic clasps may be present in precious metal jewelry due to spring mechanisms.
Jewelry testing is only performed upon request, using acid testing. Any post-purchase testing is the buyer’s responsibility, and refunds will not be issued based on authenticity disputes.
Designer items are not authenticated unless specifically stated.
Watches may not include batteries; functionality is not guaranteed.
Lot Listings
Lots may contain mixed items (e.g., jewelry, watches, coins, toys, sports/trading cards, marbles, Legos, etc.).
Items in lots may be unsorted and can include broken, dirty, tangled, or incomplete pieces. Stones, beads, or parts may be missing.
Due to volume, we cannot answer detailed questions about individual pieces within a lot.
Lots are non-refundable and cannot be combined with other purchases.
Authentication
Signatures and autographs are not authenticated unless specified.
Name brand items are not authenticated unless listed as Certified Authentic.
Certified items are authenticated through AuthenticateFirst.com and include a certificate in compliance with ShopGoodwill’s brand policy.
Electronics & Clocks
Tested only for powering on, unless otherwise stated.
Further testing is performed only if equipment is available, and results will be noted in the listing.
Items sold AS IS, with no refunds on functionality.
Shipping
FedEx is the only carrier used.
Shipping weights are calculated by dimensional weight; please check the on-screen shipping calculator before bidding.
Adjustments will only be made if they reduce shipping costs and do not exceed FedEx’s charges.
Maximum combined shipping weight is 20 lbs, per carrier restrictions.
Goodwill of Central Illinois is not responsible for items lost or stolen in transit. Please follow up directly with the carrier for claims.
Placing a bid on any item is an indication that you agree to the terms mentioned above.

description:
John P. Koehler
Blown Glass Cattail Sculpture
Art Glass, Agate, and Burl Wood
10" x 4" x 5"
Signed and dated 1992 on base
This intricate mixed media sculpture by artist John P. Koehler captures a stylized natural scene through a sophisticated combination of organic and artisanal materials. The work features hand-blown glass cattails accented with gold-tone luster and delicate clear glass reeds, all emerging from a base crafted from natural burl wood and polished agate geode slices. The composition reflects the studio glass movement of the late 20th century, emphasizing the contrast between the translucent, fragile nature of glass and the raw, earthy textures of stone and wood.
Features two distinct gold-flecked blown glass cattails and multiple slender glass reeds
Base constructed from a natural burl wood segment integrated with polished agate slices
Hand-signed and dated "7-1992" by the artist on the underside
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition. The glass elements are free of chips, cracks, or repairs. The burl wood and agate base are structurally sound with all components securely mounted. The signature on the underside remains clear and legible, and the four protective felt pads are present.

description:

The back of each piece has a rough natural surface, and the pieces can be used as bookends or as shelf decor. The set includes both matching halves.

Condition: Some small natural pits and rough areas along the edges and the backs. No chips or cracks are noticeable. Light dust or surface marks may be present.

We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.

Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.

Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

Title:
Geode Piece Brazil Crystal Mineral Specimen Decorator Collectible
Condition:
Used
Condition Description:
Good, some natural surface wear
Category:
Collectibles & Art
Country Of Origin:
Brazil
Description:
This striking geode piece from Brazil brings the natural elegance of crystal formations right to your space. One side has been smoothly sliced and polished to display a brilliant array of sparkling quartz-like crystals radiating from the center, while the rugged back and natural edges retain the original rocky matrix and earth-toned hues. The transition from the light interior to the deep, banded dark edge adds depth and visual intrigue. Perfect as a decorator piece, its versatile half-round shape allows for easy upright display on desks, shelves, or mantels. The polished interior surface maximizes its visual impact by catching and refracting light, creating a subtle shimmer from multiple angles, while the unrefined back reinforces the raw beauty of natural minerals. This geode decor item is a wonderful addition to mineral collections, office environments, or as a distinctive accent in home decor. Condition is good, with expected variations and surface characteristics from the natural stone and past handling.

Description:
Discover a unique collector's item with this vintage boxed set of crystal rock specimens from Salzbergwerk Berchtesgaden, Germany. The set includes six individual crystal samples neatly housed in their original labeled compartments, each representing different types of salt and mineral stones. These include red, gray, white, yellow, and dark red rock salt varieties, along with an anhydrite gypsum piece as indicated by the German-language insert. The samples retain their natural crystalline texture and are presented in a charming retro box with detailed informational text and decorative artwork reflecting the rich mining heritage of the Berchtesgaden region. The box shows visible signs of age-related wear and some soiling, and the crystals display minor surface residue but remain in solid condition. Ideal for collectors of geological or mineral specimens, educational purposes, or display, this set provides a fascinating glimpse into mineral diversity and European mining history. Enhance your collection with this distinctive presentation from a renowned salt mining area

description:
Polished Orthoceras Fossil Specimen with Multiple Cephalopods in Stone Matrix
This polished Orthoceras fossil specimen features multiple elongated fossilized cephalopods embedded in a black and gray stone matrix. The fossils display long cylindrical shapes with white to light gray chamber patterns, characteristic of this extinct marine animal from the Devonian period. The specimen has a partially polished surface with some raw areas, providing contrast and a natural appearance. It measures approximately 6 to 8 inches in height and is in good condition with minor chips consistent with natural stone fossils. Suitable for fossil collectors, educational displays, or decorative use.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
